notes: The 'Arduino MKR family board' is generic and not a catalogue type; arduino-mkr-wifi-1010 was used as a stand-in (the tutorial says any MKR board works).

The MKR board is mounted on the shield's header; modelled as joined+electrical on the shield's MKR_HEADER port. Relay 1 and 2 control lines (pins 1 and 2) are wired internally on the shield, so no wires are added.

The optional LED circuit (IMG05, not visible) is inferred from the sketch: LED_1 on pin 3 and LED_2 on pin 4, each through a resistor (220 ohm assumed) to GND. Breadboard hole positions are assumed; pins 3/4 and GND are taken from the MKR board with jumper wires.
The high-power lamp example (24V supply and bulb on the NC/COM screw terminals) is a discussion-only illustration and is not part of the main build, so it is omitted.
The tutorial's connector MCP servers (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive) need authorization via claude.ai connector settings; they were not needed here.
